findings.reason: Lines 37-38 expand `${{ inputs.run_id }}` into the run script with no env indirection and no numeric check, and the job holds `issues: write`. Only users with write access can dispatch, so medium is the right severity.
findings.claim: The workflow_dispatch `run_id` input is put straight into the shell script, which allows command injection and extra GITHUB_OUTPUT keys.
findings.evidence: Line 37 `[ -n "${{ inputs.run_id }}" ]` and line 38 `echo "id=${{ inputs.run_id }}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"` expand the expression before bash runs, so an input like `"; curl … ; echo "` becomes shell code.
